#!/bin/bash

# Create a gzip-compressed tar archive

# Compress the docs directory
zip -9 docs/docs.tar.gz docs

# Create a gzip compressed tar archive
gzip docs/docs.tar.gz

# Clean up the non-compressed tar archive
rm docs/docs.tar.gz
